title: T1055.004 — Process Injection - Asynchronous Procedure Call
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - Asynchronous Procedure Call with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation of Early Bird APC injection: a dropper creates a suspended Windows process, writes shellcode into it, queues the payload on the main thread with QueueUserAPC, and resumes it so the code runs before the real program, while the SOC correlates Sysmon and EDR evidence.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: A macro-free lure script runs on the workstation and starts the dropper under the Windows script host (wscript.exe).
steps.defender: a script host spawning unusual children is the first flag; Sysmon EID 1 (EID means event ID) records it.
